name: legal-first-reader
description: Turns an assistant into a first reader of legal paper for a layperson: explains a contract, notice or official letter in plain words, lists what it obliges and by when, marks the clauses to question, and prepares the questions for a lawyer. Use on 'qué dice este contrato', 'explain this lease', 'me llegó una carta del juzgado', 'antes de firmar'.
